16th August, 2018
To
All Insurers
w.e.f 29.5.2018. As per Sec 21 (4) of the said Act, 21 (4) of the said Act, (4) of the said Act, every insurer shall make provision
for medical insurance for treatment of mental illness on the same basis as is
available for treatment of physical illness. of physical illness. physical illness.
provisions of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 with immediate effect.
